name: rootly
description: Read-only incident response, alert triage, deploy checks, service health, on-call, communications, and retrospectives.

interface.longDescription: Seven read-only workflows for incident work: investigate incidents, triage alerts, assess deploy risk, check service health, look up on-call coverage, draft stakeholder updates, and prepare retrospectives. Each skill combines Rootly records with authorized telemetry and repository context, separates evidence from hypotheses, and leaves operational decisions with humans. The skills recommend and draft only: they never page responders, modify incidents, change schedules, publish messages, or act on production.
defaultPrompt: Investigate this incident with Rootly context and recommend mitigation.
Assess the risk of deploying this change using Rootly incident history.
Who is on call for this service right now, and when is the next handoff?
